programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

programme.title: The Lying Truth
programme.desc: A rapper is accused of assault by a beautiful video vixen. He says it was consensual. One of them will be exposed as a liar when the truth is revealed.

programme.title: Complex
programme.desc: The disappearance of a beautiful woman and the murder of another, leads to the investigation of four different families, living inside of one apartment complex.

programme.title: Complexx: The Two Exes
programme.desc: Dane is in a constant battle with love and lust. Haunted by both his dead sister and his mother, he fights his torment while being pursued by two ex-girlfriends. When the two women end up moving into his building, they begin a war of manipulation, on top of a masked killer running through the building. Who will make it out alive?

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: Toxic King
programme.desc: Keeng is searching for love in all the wrong places. After years of trouble relationships, he decides to just be a playboy and become a “serial love hopper” that is until he reunites with Zuri, a college friend who he has always had a crush on. Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

programme.title: Danger of Entrapment
programme.desc: A post on social media reports that eleven black girls have gone missing. The police, the mayor, and the community want to know the truth, causing a special task force to be assembled to investigate the report.

programme.title: Cuzzo
programme.desc: Jealousy and betrayal ensue, when Will enlists the help of his cousin, in helping to get his wife pregnant.

programme.title: Tilt
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city’s most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka “Bunny & Clive”. When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: Mistress for Hire
programme.desc: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric’s wife, Octavia, won’t allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's

programme.desc: Josh takes a job protecting a deaf teenage girl and keeping everyone off the father's place for a day or two. Although initially bored, Josh starts to develop a relationship with the friendly girl.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh escorts a photographer to take a picture of his friend El Gato, who is a hilarious bandit living in the hills of Mexico with a small army. However, El Gato is new to photographs and leery.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A broke Josh is hired by a fearful man to help him elope with his sweetheart, Jane, the daughter of a local rancher. The girl's father is vehemently opposed to the marriage.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh takes a job protecting an express office employee who stole $10,000 and wants to return it before it's discovered missing. However, he had an accomplice and does not know where the accomplice is.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A Japanese woman travels to the U.S. to find a man who proposed to her and hires Josh to find him since no one will help her. Josh is confronted by the Japanese man to whom she had been promised.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh arrives in town thinking the sheriff summoned him to go after a man. Instead, a woman wants Josh to bring in the man, her wanted husband, alive, so he can prove self defense.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: While pursuing Carl Martin, Josh stops at a marshal's office and is falsely accused of the marshal's murder.

programme.desc: An old man with an Apache bodyguard is wanted for a crime committed long ago.

programme.desc: A ranch manager hires Randall to bring back a line rider charged with grand theft.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: In this action-packed adventure, we push deep into the remote forests west of Timmins with an incredible young angler, Cohen. By day, Cohen runs a thriving electrical company—but his true passion lies in exploring Northern Ontario’s untouched back lakes. Together, we hit one of his favourite remote gems for a fast-paced day of walleye fishing. Stunning scenery, untouched waters, and nonstop action make this trip one to remember. Join us as Cohen showcases the spirit of Northern adventure and the rewards of getting off the beaten path.

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Era la noche anterior a la batalla final, ¡y muchas criaturas se agitan! Yugi jura derrocar a Pegaso por el bien de su abuelo. Tristán lidera un grupo de exploración para descubrir los secretos de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai se ha recuperado de su anterior derrota contra Joey convirtiéndose en una mejor duelista. ¿Ha aprendido Yugi de su derrota contra Kaiba, o la derrota emocional sigue pesando en su corazón? La respuesta está en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 1
programme.desc: Orgulloso de su fuerza como duelista en el juego, Joey desafía a Yugi para tener derecho a enfrentarse a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 2
programme.desc: Yugi se horroriza cuando Joey utiliza la carta del Mago del Tiempo contra él, ¡la misma carta que él le dio a Joey en señal de amistad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey descubre que la percepción extrasensorial de Espa Roba es un engaño, ¡pero no se ha librado de sus manipulaciones! El Jinzo de Espa Roba mata a todos los monstruos de Joey y aumenta su poder en cada turno. ¿Ha llegado a su fin la suerte de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 1
programme.desc: Arkana, el mago duelista, transporta a Yugi a la arena de duelo más letal del mundo, donde el perdedor es enviado al Reino de las Sombras. Yugi debe ganar este duelo o perderá mucho más que a su Mago Oscuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 2
programme.desc: ¡Es Mago Oscuro contra Mago Oscuro! Sin embargo, mientras Yugi solo controla un Mago Oscuro, Arkana tiene tres en su mazo. Aunque le superan en número, Yugi nunca se rendirá, ¡mientras crea en el corazón de las cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Mago: Parte 3
programme.desc: Para contrarrestar al Mago Oscuro de Arkana, Yugi saca un conejo de su chistera: ¡La Maga Oscura! ¡Es la batalla de los sexos para determinar quién es el verdadero maestro de los magos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta a otro de los nefastos Cazadores de Rarezas de Marik: ¡el silencioso pero mortal Cuerdas! Cuerdas bloquea todos los ataques de Yugi con Gelatina Reanimada, un limo resbaladizo que resucita cada vez que lo destruyen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuerdas convoca a una de las criaturas más poderosas de la historia de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡el dios egipcio Slifer el Dragón del Cielo! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene la banda de monstruos mortales de Yugi contra un dios egipcio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El hechizo Cartas Infinitas permite a Cuerdas tener un número ilimitado de cartas en su mazo, ¡así que Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Cuerdas puede crecer hasta un poder de ataque infinito!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al duelista del mar Mako Tsunami y su grupo de bestias submarinas. Si Joey gana, tendrá las seis cartas de localización necesarias para entrar en las finales de Ciudad de las Batallas, pero si pierde, ¡tendrá que despedirse dels finales!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El guerrero marino de Mako, el Pescador Legendario, desata una ola de destrucción que va destruyendo a los monstruos de Joey! ¡Joey tiene que recurrir a sus habilidades, su entrenamiento y su experiencia antes de que todo se acabe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 1: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Los secuestros abundan! Marik, con la ayuda de Bakura, secuestra a Joey y Téa. Además, los Cazadores de Rarezas también secuestran a Mokuba para obligar a Yugi y Kaiba a enfrentarse a los duelistas Umbra y Lumis en lo alto de un rascacielos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 2: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis y Umbra destruyen sistemáticamente el caótico trabajo en equipo de Yugi y Kaiba. ¿Podrán Yugi y Kaiba aprender a dejar de lado sus diferencias antes de ser enviados a un viaje sin retorno al Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 3: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra

programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
